claims.claim_text: This report asks what exact-certificate architecture could eventually support primitive-geodesic ownership decisions for a source-locked Bolza surface and one frozen nonarithmetic genus-two control at \(\Lambda=21/10\).
Stage 1 executed a closed-corpus literature synthesis, not a census or algorithm validation.

The recorded synthesis organizes object, candidate-generation, conjugacy, root-decision, owner-semantics, rigorous-predicate, and producer-checker design questions; it does not validate their project applicability or identify a project owner.
The review-adjudicated architecture permits two surface-specific exact proof producers, provided they emit one common semantic owner-certificate schema checked by an independent validator.

The schema separates full-group conjugacy, maximal-root and primitivity evidence, external inversion pairing, self-reciprocity, repetitions, termination, completeness, and positive or negative replay payloads.
It requires no common internal solver or input model.
Production implementation remains absent.
The target-empty and control-nonempty directions at the frozen cutoff are unverified inherited architecture-only assumptions.

If each direction is later replayed with source- and hypothesis-adequate proof records, it may condition the corresponding producer obligation; until then neither direction is a scientific result or a basis for between-surface arithmetic inference.
P33-RC-1 remains a producer-soundness, schema-interoperability, and independent-validation contract with a fail-closed not-evaluable endpoint.
The contribution is a proposed interoperable certificate-methods design.

A fourteen-of-fourteen match between same-lineage synthetic fixtures, their expected-outcome oracle, and their harness is retained only as a non-scientific diagnostic record, not evidence of contract correctness, independent validation, or scientific validity.
This report is not a census, novelty claim, magnetic or determinant result, formal Route-A tuple, A0/A1/A2 closure, Route-A credit, or Route-B progress.

若\hspace{0pt}日\hspace{0pt}後\hspace{0pt}分\hspace{0pt}別\hspace{0pt}以\hspace{0pt}來\hspace{0pt}源\hspace{0pt}與\hspace{0pt}假\hspace{0pt}設\hspace{0pt}充\hspace{0pt}分\hspace{0pt}的\hspace{0pt}證\hspace{0pt}明\hspace{0pt}記\hspace{0pt}錄\hspace{0pt}成\hspace{0pt}功\hspace{0pt}重\hspace{0pt}播\hspace{0pt}，才\hspace{0pt}可\hspace{0pt}把\hspace{0pt}相\hspace{0pt}應\hspace{0pt}方\hspace{0pt}向\hspace{0pt}作\hspace{0pt}為\hspace{0pt}條\hspace{0pt}件\hspace{0pt}式\hspace{0pt}的\hspace{0pt}產\hspace{0pt}生\hspace{0pt}器\hspace{0pt}輸\hspace{0pt}入\hspace{0pt}；在\hspace{0pt}此\hspace{0pt}之\hspace{0pt}前\hspace{0pt}，兩\hspace{0pt}端\hspace{0pt}差\hspace{0pt}異\hspace{0pt}不\hspace{0pt}得\hspace{0pt}支\hspace{0pt}持\hspace{0pt}空\hspace{0pt}與\hspace{0pt}非\hspace{0pt}空\hspace{0pt}比\hspace{0pt}較\hspace{0pt}、算\hspace{0pt}術\hspace{0pt}性\hspace{0pt}推\hspace{0pt}論\hspace{0pt}、A0/A1/A2 關\hspace{0pt}閉\hspace{0pt}、Route A 計\hspace{0pt}分\hspace{0pt}或\hspace{0pt} Route B 進\hspace{0pt}展\hspace{0pt}。P33-RC-1 的\hspace{0pt}七\hspace{0pt}項\hspace{0pt}義\hspace{0pt}務\hspace{0pt}仍\hspace{0pt}為\hspace{0pt}零\hspace{0pt}項\hspace{0pt}完\hspace{0pt}成\hspace{0pt}；產\hspace{0pt}生\hspace{0pt}器\hspace{0pt}、綱\hspace{0pt}要\hspace{0pt}、驗\hspace{0pt}證\hspace{0pt}器\hspace{0pt}與\hspace{0pt}普\hspace{0pt}查\hspace{0pt}均\hspace{0pt}未\hspace{0pt}實\hspace{0pt}作\hspace{0pt}。

本\hspace{0pt}文\hspace{0pt}的\hspace{0pt}落\hspace{0pt}地\hspace{0pt}成\hspace{0pt}果\hspace{0pt}是\hspace{0pt}可\hspace{0pt}稽\hspace{0pt}核\hspace{0pt}的\hspace{0pt}憑\hspace{0pt}證\hspace{0pt}方\hspace{0pt}法\hspace{0pt}設\hspace{0pt}計\hspace{0pt}，而\hspace{0pt}不\hspace{0pt}是\hspace{0pt}已\hspace{0pt}完\hspace{0pt}成\hspace{0pt}的\hspace{0pt}科\hspace{0pt}學\hspace{0pt}普\hspace{0pt}查\hspace{0pt}、磁\hspace{0pt}流\hspace{0pt}或\hspace{0pt}行\hspace{0pt}列\hspace{0pt}式\hspace{0pt}結\hspace{0pt}果\hspace{0pt}，也\hspace{0pt}不\hspace{0pt}是\hspace{0pt} Route A 或\hspace{0pt} Route B 的\hspace{0pt}正\hspace{0pt}式\hspace{0pt}結\hspace{0pt}論\hspace{0pt}。

Canonical records use UTF-8 in NFC form, no byte-order mark, LF line endings, byte-lexicographically ordered object keys, prescribed array order, and no insignificant whitespace.

Integers use unsigned or explicitly signed base-10 strings without leading zeros; a rational uses the canonical byte-order object \texttt{\{den,num\}}, where \texttt{den} is positive, \texttt{num} is signed, and the two integers are coprime; floating-point numbers, NaN, infinities, duplicate keys, and unknown fields are forbidden.
